title: Decision agreement benchmark v1
sequence: Specified after count-based Indonesia validation and case results had been inspected, before computing this decision benchmark. Evaluation years excluded from fitting are not an untouched benchmark.
sources: Existing pinned Indonesia sparse monthly data and raw source manifest. Area inclusion uses 0.25 degree cell centres, as in released explorer.
baseline: Aqua calendar-month medians and p90 from 2003–2017; never include audited year. No coverage normalization; baseline observational completeness remains unknown.
methods: single national overlap ratio fitted on original training years
categories: 0: at or below historical median; 1: above median but at or below p90; 2: above p90. Categories are descriptive, not significance tests.
exclude: August and September 2020 from NPP decision audit owing to documented Aqua outage. Exclude entire 2020 from annual-window tests. Do not refit released model or single factor after seeing results.
gate: Retrospective diagnostic support: baseline median >=5 and concurrent Aqua and VIIRS occupied counts both >=20. Same gate for every model, no tuning. This does not establish clear-sky coverage and cannot operate unchanged after Aqua retires.
metrics: balanced accuracy across reference classes present
above-p90 precision and recall against Aqua
annual cyclic three-month maximum start-month error and exact agreement
critical_window: For each complete audit region/year, choose consecutive cyclic 3-month sum maximum for each method and Aqua. Ties choose earliest start month. Report minimum circular start difference in months, not onset timing or forecasts.
aggregation: Five study rectangles pooled with equal region-month weight; some rectangles overlap and observations are not independent. Also publish each region and year; no population inference or confidence interval.
comparison: Aqua is reference, not ground truth. Report every method even if released calibration loses. No headline replacement or coefficient changes automatically follow this diagnostic. External practitioner validation deferred.
